name: Tarte au citron Eulerian
description: Registers Eulerian analytics as a consent-gated service in the Tarte au citron consent manager, so the Eulerian tag and its cookies load only after (or, optionally, exempt from) visitor consent.
project_description: Bridge module that plugs Eulerian analytics into the Tarte au citron consent manager. It supplies a single Tarte au citron service plugin (id 'eulerian-analytics', class Drupal\eulerian_tarte_au_citron\Plugin\tarte_au_citron\Eulerian, extending ServicePluginBase) plus two front-end JS registrations and three hook implementations. When the service requires consent (default), page_attachments_alter removes the eulerian/init library so the Eulerian tag is not fired on page load; instead js/service-tarte-au-citron.js registers the tag with tarteaucitron and only builds and pushes the Eulerian collect tag (from drupalSettings.eulerian.domain / drupalSettings.eulerian.datalayer, provided by the base Eulerian module) once the visitor consents. A 'Need consent' checkbox on the Tarte au citron service settings lets an admin instead run Eulerian without consent (using Eulerian's TCFv2 CMP feature to stay GDPR-compliant); in that mode library_info_alter appends the eulerian_tarte_au_citron/service.eulerian bridge to Eulerian's init library. The module owns no routes, permissions, config objects, config schema, entities or Drush commands, and its plugin settings are stored inside the tarte_au_citron.settings config of the Tarte au citron module.
